structured.answer: The cheapest stock index tracker for a kupat gemel lehashkaa is a tie: Harel (15040) and Altshuler Shaham (14864), both 0.56% a year and 0% on deposits. Menora is next at 0.57% plus 0.02% on deposits. I'd go with Harel.
